abilities.Bad Dreams: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.
abilities.Multitype: If this Pokemon is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.
abilities.Victory Star: This Pokemon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.
abilities.Zen Mode: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.
abilities.Mummy: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy.
abilities.Defeatist: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its max HP, its Attack and Sp. Atk are halved.
abilities.Illusion: This Pokemon appears as the last Pokemon in the party until it takes direct damage.
abilities.Iron Barbs: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.
abilities.Turboblaze: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
abilities.Teravolt: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
abilities.Bulletproof: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.
abilities.Magician: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack.
abilities.Battle Bond: After KOing a Pokemon: raises Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed by 1 stage. Once per battle.
abilities.Cheek Pouch: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it restores 1/3 of its max HP after the Berry's effect.
abilities.Gale Wings: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.
abilities.Flower Veil: This side's Grass types can't have stats lowered or status inflicted by other Pokemon.
abilities.Symbiosis: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately.
abilities.Grass Pelt: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.Stance Change: If Aegislash, changes Forme to Blade before attacks and Shield before King's Shield.
abilities.Aroma Veil: Protects user/allies from Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, and Torment.
abilities.Sweet Veil: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep; those already asleep do not wake up.
abilities.Gooey: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.
abilities.Fairy Aura: While this Pokemon is active, a Fairy move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.
abilities.Dark Aura: While this Pokemon is active, a Dark move used by any Pokemon has 1.33× power.
abilities.Aura Break: While this Pokemon is active, the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura power modifier is 0.75×.
abilities.Power Construct: If Zygarde 10%/50%, changes to Complete if at 1/2 max HP or less at end of turn.
abilities.Long Reach: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.
abilities.Liquid Voice: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water type.
abilities.Stakeout: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled against a target that switched in this turn.
abilities.Battery: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their special attacks multiplied by 1.3.
abilities.Dancer: After another Pokemon uses a dance move, this Pokemon uses the same move.
abilities.Schooling: If user is Wishiwashi, changes to School Form if it has > 1/4 max HP, else Solo Form.
abilities.Merciless: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.
abilities.Stamina: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.
abilities.Water Bubble: This Pokemon's Water power is 2×; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.
abilities.Corrosion: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.
abilities.Fluffy: This Pokemon takes 1/2 damage from contact moves, 2× damage from Fire moves.
abilities.Queenly Majesty: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
abilities.Triage: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
abilities.Receiver: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.
abilities.Wimp Out: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
abilities.Emergency Exit: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
abilities.Water Compaction: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.
abilities.Innards Out: If this Pokemon is KOed with a move, that move's user loses an equal amount of HP.
abilities.RKS System: If this Pokemon is a Silvally, its type changes to match its held Memory.
abilities.Shields Down: If Minior, switch-in/end of turn it changes to Core at 1/2 max HP or less, else Meteor.
abilities.Comatose: This Pokemon cannot be statused, and is considered to be asleep.
abilities.Disguise: (Mimikyu only) The first hit it takes is blocked, and it takes 1/8 HP damage instead.
abilities.Dazzling: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
abilities.Berserk: This Pokemon's Sp. Atk is raised by 1 when it reaches 1/2 or less of its max HP.
abilities.Steelworker: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Steel-type attack.
abilities.Electric Surge: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.
abilities.Psychic Surge: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.
abilities.Grassy Surge: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
abilities.Misty Surge: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Misty Terrain.
abilities.Full Metal Body: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
abilities.Shadow Shield: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
abilities.Beast Boost: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
abilities.Prism Armor: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.
abilities.Soul-Heart: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokemon faints.
